counts_note: 32 confirmed eggs, 13 reported eggs, 6 disputed eggs, 7 confirmed bugs, 13 reported bugs, 4 disputed bugs, 3 confirmed weird, 8 reported weird — 86 items total
note: The game is 2 days old. Nothing here is officially confirmed by Rockstar. Having a video of something is not the same as it being proven. Status: confirmed = 2+ independent sources; reported = 1 source; disputed = conflicting sources or doubtful evidence.

items.description: A tall hairy creature eats a deer carcass on the road south of Lake Cottonmouth, in the Grassrivers swamps. Approach and it runs into the trees; follow it to a carved wooden effigy tied to a tree, walk up to it, and your character faints — a cutscene shows hairy feet walking into view.
items.location: Road south of Lake Cottonmouth, Grassrivers
items.name: Skunk Ape / Bigfoot
items.reference: Florida's Skunk Ape cryptid — Rockstar's Bigfoot gag, running since GTA: San Andreas

sources.name: Game8 — All Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: A flyer headed Have You Seen Skunk Ape??? at Skeeter's Bar in Hamlet gives Kirk's number, 461-555-0139. Call him for 3 night missions hunting Mr. Mangrove. The twist: Mr. Mangrove is Harry Sherrick, a man missing for 10 years. At the end, shoot him ($10,000 + the Laird 350 rifle) or do not — if you do not, Kirk dies. Counts toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy.
items.location: Skeeter's Bar, Hamlet; swamps of Grassrivers
items.name: Kirk & Mr. Mangrove

items.description: After Chapter 1, go ALONE to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 02:00 in-game time. Find a parked car with flashing lights, follow the trail of clothes into the woods toward a blue light — a UFO is lifting a woman. Agree to fetch her car, walk back to the car on the road, and the UFO returns and abducts YOU. The trophy The Truth Is Out There pops.
items.location: Road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 02:00
items.name: UFO abduction
items.reference: Trophy: The Truth Is Out There

items.description: After the abduction, your character dreams — note the number above the keypad in the dream (usually 2134; see disputed item D4). Go to the radio tower at South Point Airfield, Hamlet (alternative: the Abandoned Site north-east of Lake Cottonmouth). Enter the keypad code, take the lift to the basement, press the panel buttons until all lights are green, pull the lever, take the milk bottle from the table (through the left door, watch for radiation) and put it in the capsule in the right room — a small grey alien appears. Carry it out before the poison gas; a UFO comes to collect the alien.
items.location: Radio tower, South Point Airfield, Hamlet
items.name: Alien prisoner in an underground lab

items.description: Climb the tallest radio tower in South Vice-Dale (about 7 minutes) to find a bird's nest at the top containing a painted egg — a literal Easter egg. Pick it up and throw it from the top: a cutscene shows the egg falling onto the windshield of a car below, driven by a shady real-estate agent / lawyer.
items.location: Top of the tallest radio tower, South Vice-Dale
items.name: Literal Easter egg on the radio tower
items.reference: The classic Rockstar Easter egg joke, made literal

sources.name: Game8 — All Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: An abandoned research station south-west of Pelican Valley (take a boat, north of Key Lento). Turn on the power; the computer password is CLEAVES (carved into the floor). A note reads SAFE CODE = DOUBLE SUCCESS and a clipboard reads SUCCESS = 0036, so the safe code is 0072 — about $1,070–$1,098 inside. A giant mutant crab then crashes down and attacks. In the boathouse, code 0212 opens: the SMG Crabshack VF5, a bag with $10,000, and a jet ski.
items.location: Abandoned research station, south-west of Pelican Valley
items.name: Giant mutant crab / Crab Lab

items.description: Get stranded far out at sea (Gambit Bay) and a dog wearing goggles arrives on a jet ski to rescue you. It takes you to an island full of dogs, and gives you money and the goggles. There is reportedly a hidden money stash there too.
items.name: Cool Dog / Lucky Dog
items.reference: The jet-ski dog, officially named Cool Dog

sources.name: Game8 — All Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: Washington Island, Trinity Apartments, 2nd floor, near the Pay 'N' Spray. On the roof: a kill kit (needle, knife, duct tape, rope), and a boat called Slice of Life is docked nearby. The apartment itself cannot be entered.
items.name: Dexter Morgan's apartment
items.reference: Dexter (TV series) — Dexter Morgan's Miami apartment

sources.name: Game8 — All Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: Inside a villa garage on Vespucci Island, Rialto Islands: a lime-green car with a Terada Tires decal and a rear wing. It can be stolen and registered at a Pay 'n' Spray. The model is the Maibatsu Penumbra FF, plate HAD YOU.
items.location: Villa garage, Vespucci Island, Rialto Islands
items.name: Brian O'Conner's Mitsubishi Eclipse
items.reference: The Fast and the Furious (2001) — Brian O'Conner's 1995 Mitsubishi Eclipse

sources.name: Game8 — All Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: Outside Jason's house in the Leonida Keys sits a boat — the same one stolen from Michael in GTA V. Climb aboard and check the GPS behind the steering wheel: it still shows the Los Santos map.
items.name: Michael De Santa's boat

sources.name: Game8 — All Easter Eggs and Secrets
Games.gg — GTA 6 Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: A yard sale south of Port Gellhorn (north-west of Dirt Merchants, above the race track). The hat sits on a guitar case on a sofa: $35 for a Genuine Cowboy Hat. Available from Chapter 2; Jason and Lucia can both wear it.
items.location: Yard sale, south of Port Gellhorn
items.name: Arthur Morgan's cowboy hat

sources.name: Game8 — All Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: Behind Three Sheets Liquor, Key Lento — after the mission about Shirley's house. A red parrot in a cage gives hints about a stash (Generator… Generator). A vent near the generator holds about $1,200–$1,384, and the shop safe holds about $971.
items.location: Behind Three Sheets Liquor, Key Lento
items.name: Tony the talking parrot
items.reference: GTA: San Andreas — the talking parrot

items.description: Chapter 5, Top of the World, Ma, mission Taking Liberties: in Giorgio's penthouse, two cutscenes feature a hitman voiced by Michael Hollick, credited as The Hitman. He says Daddy's back, bitches! and the theme Soviet Connection plays. This is late-story content, not a hidden egg — it is listed here because it is a returning-character cameo.
items.name: Niko Bellic cameo ('The Hitman')
items.reference: GTA IV — Niko Bellic, voiced by Michael Hollick

sources.name: Game8 — All Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: Early in the story, Donnie calls to meet Brian; in the bar next door, two NPCs discuss the Mount Chiliad madness — the bunker and the jetpack under the mountain.
items.location: Bar next to Brian's meeting spot (early story)
items.name: Mount Chiliad bar conversation
items.reference: GTA V — the Mount Chiliad mystery (bunker + jetpack)

items.description: In Belville, Leonard County, break into a garage to find a conspiracy board — the resident knows he is living inside a video game. A red mind-map reads IT'S A SIMULATION. Found by Jared (community mapping). A mysterious 2021 photo in the San Andreas Definitive Edition has now been explained.
items.name: Belville conspiracy house ('IT'S A SIMULATION')
items.reference: The 2021 San Andreas Definitive Edition mystery photo

items.description: The Body Copy magazine in Jason's gym carries an article called Twilight Tantra about Fabien LaRouche — Amanda's yoga instructor from GTA V, now teaching at the Dwindle Wood Retirement Community, Waning Sands.
items.name: Fabien LaRouche in a magazine
items.reference: GTA V — Fabien LaRouche, Amanda's yoga instructor

sources.name: Game8 — All Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: On the back plate of an Imponte Phoenix — the red Phoenix appears in the Chapter 1 mission Unwanted Attention. The plate reads ASS MAN.
items.name: 'ASS MAN' plate (Seinfeld)
items.reference: Seinfeld — The Fusilli Jerry (the ASSMAN plate)

items.description: A Love Fist sticker appears in the world, and Jason wears a T-shirt with the V-Rock logo.
items.name: Love Fist & V-Rock
items.reference: GTA: Vice City — Love Fist band and V-Rock radio

items.description: A sticker reading Petty Forever on the door of Uncle Jack's liquor store.
items.name: 'Petty Forever' sticker (Tom Petty)

items.description: A book in Jason's house: the memoir of Tom Everett, bodyguard of Gracie Ancelotti, who survived because he was sick the day a gunman killed 5 guards. Another book mentions the 2008 events.
items.name: Tom Everett memoir / Liberty City 2008 book

sources.name: Games.gg — GTA 6 Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: The true-crime podcast Final Act, hosted by Reagan Carter, covers the deaths of Floyd and Debra. Wade Hebert appears — reportedly at a titty bar. A photo shows 3 men; the show names Michael De Santa and Franklin Clinton, and a third man is called my best friend without a name (Trevor).
items.name: Wade Hebert on the 'Final Act' podcast
items.reference: GTA V — Wade Hebert, Floyd and Debra

items.description: A flyer with a skull on the notice board outside Three Sheets Liquor, Key Lento: the Rad Dads Redemption Tour poster.
items.location: Notice board outside Three Sheets Liquor, Key Lento
items.name: 'Rad Dads Redemption Tour' poster
items.reference: GTA V — the Rad Dads band poster

items.description: A random car plate reading New Austin, with a cactus and desert sunset design.
items.name: 'New Austin' plate

items.description: Postcards of the Grand Senora Desert and Grapeseed on the wall of a trailer at a burnt-out fishing property.
items.location: Trailer at a burnt-out fishing property (photo wall)
items.name: Grand Senora Desert & Grapeseed postcards
items.reference: GTA V — Grand Senora Desert, Grapeseed

items.description: In the phone settings, the Wind Chimes ringtone is available — the same ringtone Michael used in GTA V.
items.name: 'Wind Chimes' ringtone
items.reference: GTA V — Michael De Santa's ringtone

sources.name: Games.gg — GTA 6 Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: West of North Leonard County: a Snapmatic post points to a fortified compound. Enter via the watchtower, then the warehouse roof. Mines and drones guard it. Choose to stay with Freddie and you get the Dubster and $5,000.
items.name: Freddie's bunker (Freddie Gibbs)
items.reference: Freddie Gibbs — the rapper's in-game bunker

items.description: A comic called RX-Men — a parody of X-Men with drug-themed superheroes and a villain named Dr. Placebo.
items.name: 'RX-Men' comic

items.description: Strangers & Freaks: meet Kyle McKittrick at the giant strawberry farm (Lucia knew him first). Help in the garden, collect chemicals; Kyle eats a strange strawberry and mutates into a giant red monster — throwing an NPC at a helicopter (it falls), flipping a car, bulletproof. Jason calms him down (Buddy). You choose whether to hug him or not. Found live by IShowSpeed after about 23 hours of play. Whether hugging him makes him appear again is NOT confirmed.
items.name: Kyle the 'Red Hulk'

items.description: An abandoned building in Capri, south of Tortoise Lake (north of Capri, near the railway): a bloody pentagram, candles, a ritual journal. Knock an NPC out at a construction site, drag them to the pentagram — the screen goes dark, the candles light, your partner calls (hallucination: your partner is possessed, other characters turn into demons). The NPC rises as a demon; only fire kills it (Molotov / petrol — bullets and explosions do not work). NOTE: the claim by TechTudo that this ritual opens the trophy The Truth Is Out There CONFLICTS with PowerPyx (UFO) — see disputed item D5.
items.location: Abandoned building, Capri, south of Tortoise Lake
items.name: Capri demon / satanic ritual
items.reference: Occult ritual; conflicts with the UFO trigger for The Truth Is Out There

items.description: Ocean Beach, Vice Beach: Tommy Vercetti's first safehouse (Vice City, 2002). It appears in Trailer 1 (0:33) and Trailer 2 (bar + pool). The rooftop bar is where the trophy In The Beginning… unlocks (Apple Martini, $10).
items.name: Ocean View Hotel
items.reference: GTA: Vice City — Tommy Vercetti's first safehouse

items.description: A secret ending: a black-and-white puzzle game on the JoySystem console in Jason's house. Behind a locked door, a phone in a bunker asks for a 6-digit code, found from anomalies in rooms marked with October dates (a wrong clock, a photo with an extra person, a phone ringing a different number of times) — the code differs per save. Finish it and the door at the end of the pier opens; you wake up in a dark cabin with a developer desk and 2 monitors.
items.name: Tenebrae Lux — secret ending
items.reference: Playable game Tenebrae Lux; also a trophy-game (Stick Fiddler)

sources.name: Games.gg — GTA 6 Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: The host of the '80s hits radio station is Weird Al Yankovic. His name appears on Rockstar's official cast list (6,000 names, 19 Nov).
items.name: 'Weird Al' Yankovic — radio host

items.description: Allegedly in the game. One source, explicitly marked allegedly — Rockstar has not confirmed it.
items.name: Sam Houser cameo?

items.description: A fat merman sunbathing on a small island in Gambit Bay. One source, no exact location.
items.name: Fat merman

items.description: A meteorite on a mountain peak in Lummox County (WikiGames) / on the south-east slope of Mount Kalaga near a camp, plus a phone containing a recording of a UFO abduction (Sportskeeda). It is still glowing and pieces can be collected. The two sources give different locations, so they cannot be merged into one entry yet.
items.location: Lummox County peak / south-east slope of Mount Kalaga — locations disagree
items.name: Meteorite

items.description: A beached whale that can explode. Beach area; one source.
items.name: Beached whale that can explode

items.description: A rare white tiger in a locked cage. One source, no location given.
items.name: White tiger in a cage

items.description: A pet sleeping in a car trunk can attack and kill when the trunk is looted.
items.name: Animal jumpscare in the trunk
items.reference: Related to R-W4 (python in the trunk)

items.description: Steal a car that has a cat inside and a cutscene plays of the cat attacking; it can be thrown out. Two thin sources.
items.name: Cat attacks when you steal its car

items.description: Mentioned only in a GamingBible headline, with no location or method given.
items.name: Saw-style kidnapper

items.description: A face-tattooed criminal (the Florida Joker) on trial on TV, met in free roam outside a bar in Leonard County, with a stranger mission: find his stolen pet python. One doubtful source (an AI-content site). The Florida Joker in Trailer 1 IS confirmed (Beebom) — but this mission is not.
items.name: 'Gator Face' / Florida Joker mission

items.description: A UFO article in the phone's news app.
items.name: UFO article in the news app

sources.name: Games.gg — GTA 6 Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: Conspiracy eye artwork on the outside of a truck.
items.name: Mount Chiliad eye truck artwork

sources.name: Games.gg — GTA 6 Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: While climbing the radio tower (E5), an influencer is sometimes vlogging at the top. The parachute cannot be used to get down even if the influencer is removed.
items.name: Influencer vlogging at the top of the tower

sources.name: Game8 — All Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: Police who are making an arrest react when the player films them.
items.name: Police react when filmed

sources.name: Games.gg — GTA 6 Easter Eggs and Secrets

items.description: Facebook Reel, 20 Nov, reel 1988665145441723, 7,036 likes; the claim is 'Easter egg: influencer eaten by a giant python!!'. A woman takes a selfie in the swamp; a giant python pulls her leg and swallows her; her selfie stick gets stuck and chokes the snake (WikiGames version). DISPUTED: the visuals look like RDR2's style; commenters are split; WikiGames lists it without verification; NO major outlet (GameSpot / IGN / Kotaku / PowerPyx) has reported it.
items.name: Influencer eaten by a python (reel)
items.reference: Viral reel — possibly RDR2 footage, not GTA 6

items.description: Facebook Reel, 19 Nov, reel 1076172468775137, 6,722 likes; 'Not even 5 mins into the game'. NOT a clear egg — at most viral ambient animal behaviour turned into a meme. Comments question its authenticity ('I'm several hours in and this doesn't happen'); it is suspected to be AI.
items.name: Two dogs mating in a driveway (reel)
items.reference: Ambient animal behaviour, viral as a meme

items.description: BuzzFeed writes: 'According to X users... then you turn into a frog?' — with its own question mark. The verified Kirk questline (E2) ends with shoot-or-don't-shoot — there is NO frog transformation in the PowerPyx or OutputLag guides. Most likely a misreading or an X joke.
items.name: Bigfoot: 'hunt him, kill him, then you turn into a frog'
items.reference: X rumour, questioned by BuzzFeed itself

items.description: PowerPyx + YouTube walkthroughs: 2134 (from the dream). OutputLag: try 2314, then 2341 — 'none of them work on every save' (the code differs per save / dream). The egg itself is confirmed; the number cannot be fixed. Write it as: the code is seen in the dream (usually 2134; some report 2314 / 2341).
items.name: Alien lab keypad code: 2134 vs 2314 vs 2341

items.description: PowerPyx (+ GameSpot): the UFO abduction (E3). TechTudo (via Cut.pro): the Capri ritual (E29) opens the same trophy. Both cannot be true. This guide shows the UFO as the main trigger (2+ strong sources) and the Capri ritual as an unverified alternative claim.
items.location: Starlet Motel UFO (E3) vs Capri ritual (E29)
items.name: Trigger for 'The Truth Is Out There': UFO vs Capri ritual

items.description: A viral clip shows a player sitting in a car that will not move. HappyGamer: 'Treat these as unconfirmed' — it could be a car needing a Key Cloner, a tracked car, or a momentary bug. No guide has replicated it. Also listed under Bugs (D7).
items.name: 'Not every car can be stolen'

items.description: Pedestrians get stuck walking into walls in various buildings and interiors.
items.name: NPCs walk into walls

items.description: At the police station (MichaelDoesLife): Jason and a police officer clip into each other, get sucked into a wall / sofa, and roll around until the officer is knocked out.
items.name: Clipping through walls / sofas

items.description: In the prologue, Lucia is tased by police while stealing a scooter (scripted — she is always caught). The scooter's weight makes Lucia clip through the ground and fall under Leonida until the game puts her back. If it does not come back: restart and replay the mission. The most-reported bug so far.
items.name: Falling through the map (prologue)

items.description: Prologue and general, PS5 + Xbox: repeated crashes, freezes, missing textures, audio problems, hours of progress lost even though autosave exists (autosave does not always run in the prologue or at certain checkpoints; the save menu does not show autosaves — use the load menu). Mitigation: save manually often, rotate slots.
items.name: Crash / freeze / lost progress

items.description: In the mission Gone Fishing, Donnie's rescue plane has no door-opening animation: Jason clips straight through the body of the plane into the pilot's seat.
items.name: Missing airplane door animation

items.description: Frame rate drops (target 30 FPS) in dense areas and while driving, on all consoles including PS5 Pro. There is no 60 FPS / performance mode. A performance limitation, and the most common player complaint.
items.name: Frame-rate drop (target 30 FPS)

items.description: After leaving the bank early in Lucia's story, the mission cannot be completed. Workaround: reload a checkpoint or an earlier save. No statement from Rockstar.
items.location: Early Lucia mission (after leaving the bank)
items.name: Softlock in an early Lucia mission

items.description: A floating coffee cup in the safehouse when switching between Jason and Lucia.
items.name: Floating coffee cup

items.description: Brief clothing pop-in on Jason / Lucia. Seen in the pre-release patch; unclear whether it is still in the launch patch.
items.name: Cosmetic pop-in (clothing)

items.description: While driving with Jason and Cal, a boat suddenly appears tilted against a bridge, almost onto the road, then goes back.
items.name: Boat appears stuck to a bridge

items.description: In Gone Fishing, Jason rams a boat full of people with a speedboat; the NPCs do not react, and the boat does not collide or capsize.
items.name: NPCs do not react to a boat collision

items.description: Jump out before it crashes; the plane does not explode and flies through the building ahead while Jason parachutes.
items.name: Plane flies through a building (anti-crash)

items.description: Jason jumps from a moving plane without a parachute while chased by police and survives with no damage (not a cheat). The plane still explodes.
items.name: Falling from a plane without damage

items.description: Hit a tree or bush with a car and the car is flung far (like the GTA IV swing glitch, lighter). The car is totalled.
items.name: Slingshot glitch, GTA IV style

items.description: Wedge Jason between a car and a fence, open the phone, and he clips through the map and falls into a black void. Requires a restart; save manually first.
items.name: 'Phone to Shadow Realm'

items.description: Intro before the prologue: vehicle / NPC pop-in, world textures missing (like Cyberpunk 2077 1.0). One report; possibly a failed asset stream.
items.name: 'PS1' graphics / missing textures

items.description: NPCs swimming sideways in Leonida's waters.
items.name: NPCs swim sideways

items.description: Xbox Series X|S with a VRR TV: reportedly unlocks the frame rate above 30 FPS. May change with a patch; Rockstar has not commented.
items.name: VRR on Xbox unlocks frame rate

items.description: On starting the game (PS5). A generic error; reportedly gone after the 602 MB update.
items.name: PS5 error CE-108255-1

items.description: In the Progress menu, cheats reportedly appear only after all story missions are finished. While a cheat is active you cannot save and trophies do not pop in that session. Rockstar has not published an official cheat list; the count (about 61) is NOT verified.
items.name: Cheats locked until the story ends

items.description: Same as D6: a viral clip of a car that will not move. HappyGamer: treat as unconfirmed — it could be a car needing a Key Cloner, a tracked car, or a momentary bug. No guide has replicated it.
items.name: 'Not every car can be stolen'

items.description: A viral X post claims Rockstar apologised and will fix things on 25 Nov. There is NO support for it on Rockstar's official channels (Newswire / support) as of 21 Nov.
items.name: Rumor: 'Rockstar apologised + fix on 25 Nov'

items.description: Notebookcheck: 'JasonTheWeen critics believe the ordeal was staged'. Crashes and lost progress in general remain CONFIRMED (B4); only the claim that THIS one clip was staged is disputed. Do not use this accusation to discredit other crash reports.
items.name: Accusation that JasonTheWeen's crash was 'staged'
items.reference: Single-clip dispute, not a general crash denial

items.description: The red warehouse east of Hamlet. Full panel in the Glitch & Farming tab. DISPUTED: 2 for (KeeNgamer, allblogthings) vs 2 against (afleurdenet, vanotherlevel). Do not treat as confirmed.
items.name: Apollo Aggregates money glitch (reference)

items.description: Brian Heder's rental house, Key Lento. Early Chapter 1 mission Pipework: Brian sends Jason to collect rent. OBSERVED CLUES (confirmed, 3 sources): (a) while Jason fixes a clogged sink pipe, a rotting human finger comes out — Mandy panics, snatches it (Oops! Forgot about that.) and hurries Jason out; (b) her car trunk holds a meat cleaver, scissors, bleach, duct tape (FandomWire: also acid and several saws); (c) the yard has a dig that looks like a freshly dug grave (Gamebrott: covered with dry cement; FandomWire: 'a patch of disturbed ground that looks suspiciously like a freshly dug grave'); (d) Mandy flirts with Jason constantly (bikini, claims they are 'almost married' — a version Jason does not acknowledge), admits breaking appliances on purpose so Jason comes over, and stalks him via Snapmatic.
items.location: Brian Heder's rental house, Key Lento
items.name: Mandy — Key Lento (mystery)
items.reference: Mandy mystery — clues observed, theory separate
items.theory: COMMUNITY THEORY, NOT FACT: 'Mandy is a psychopath / serial killer'. No cutscene and no Rockstar statement confirms it; Gamebrott itself writes that there is no further direct explanation. Always present it as a theory.

items.description: A random event on the highway: animal activists stop a truck carrying a polar bear in a cage, open the back door shouting 'Let her out!' — the bear gets out and immediately attacks them (several are killed / mauled). Variant: a freed orca throws an activist into the air. Kotaku: the bear escapes while being transported to the zoo; if the event happens after meeting the hunter, the hunter wants to buy the dead bear.
items.name: Polar bear escapes from a truck
items.reference: Random event — activists vs polar bear

items.description: Being a furry (anthropomorphic animal costume) is illegal in Leonida: police can shoot on sight ('No Paws Laws'). There is a news article: 'Governor Declares Leonida Furry-Free'. Even saying the meme 'Uwu / Rawr xD / hewwo' can get you arrested. There is a 'furry rebels' headquarters on Starfish Island (IGN via GTA6-Life).
items.name: 'Furry illegal' in Leonida

items.description: One room in her house is locked tight; Jason cannot enter it at all. Suspected to be connected to the W1 mystery. Its contents are unknown. One source. Do NOT invent what is inside.
items.name: Mandy's locked room

items.description: A camp on the south-east trail toward the top of Mount Kalaga: a phone lies near a bicycle. It can be picked up and played — a recording of an NPC being abducted by a UFO while shouting a name (possibly a sibling warning the player not to go to that location).
items.location: Camp on the south-east trail, Mount Kalaga
items.name: UFO abduction recording on a phone

items.description: Activists free an orca; the orca throws an activist into the air.
items.name: Orca throws an activist

items.description: A python jumps out of a car trunk when the player tries to steal the car. Related to R-E6.
items.name: Python in the car trunk

items.description: Bump an NPC's car and the NPC chases you for a long time, then rams you to stop you, gets out and attacks. A far bigger reaction than in GTA V.
items.name: Extreme NPC road rage

items.description: Jason's house, early in the game: Cal installs the JoyStation, drinks all night, and in the morning wakes up spooning in the bedroom. A scripted story moment.
items.name: 'Spooning Cal'

items.description: Next to Mandy's house: Bert (described as representing the nonsensical right wing) with his trousers down, 'showing off to the tenants'. The source gives incomplete details.
items.location: Next to Mandy's house, Key Lento
items.name: Bert 'trousers down'

items.description: Dundee Culture links the polar bear event (W2) to the story of Bruin, a polar bear that escaped and roamed Dundee in 1878. An inference by a local site; it may be coincidence. Kept as REPORTED.
items.name: Dundee polar bear (1878) reference?
items.reference: Possible historical nod to Bruin's 1878 escape
